heading_1.jcr:title: Live Demo with VIPA™ Card to Support Latest Video over IP Standards

text_1.text:
Solana Beach, California – August 23, 2018 – Macnica Technology, a leader in live video over IP transport technologies, today announced it is exhibiting at IBC 2018 in Amsterdam on September 14-18 showcasing live demos for its ST2110 and NMOS solutions on its VIPA™ 10G PCI Express card at Booth 2.A18.

Macnica’s IBC2018 ST2110 video transport demos include:

  • VIPA™ PCI Express card in processor mode performing video transport interface function for video processing of ST2110 IP streams
  • New – SDI to IP Gateway Module (with an IP core for FPGA) in development to convert SDI media (video, audio, and data) to ST2110 video over IP networks
  • Macnica’s full NMOS (Network Media Open Specifications) portfolio
    • Node Side: IS-04 Discovery and Registration, IS-05 Device Connection Management
    • Switch Side: IS-06 Network Control

Please visit the Macnica booth 2.A18 at IBC 2018 in Amsterdam for more details.
A meeting room is also available at the meeting suite 15.MS10 and a technical/business meeting with Macnica’s experts can be scheduled by sending an email to videotransport@macnica.com.

Macnica is also showcasing its VIPA card and NMOS based demos at the IP Showcase, located at Room E106/107 at IBC 2018.
